caseName: Smith v. Iowa Liquor Control Commission
caseNameFull: Smith v. Iowa Liquor Control Commission

opinions.text:
Appeal from Sup. Ct. Iowa dismissed for want of jurisdiction. Treating the papers whereon the appeal ■was taken as a petition for writ of certiorari, certiorari denied.

Mr. Justice Douglas is of the opinion that probable jurisdiction should be noted and case set for oral argument.
